verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or portability capability for leaving TrueLayer. Console can 'generate reports' and show 'balance reports', but nothing says these can be exported, in what format, or that they cover all account data. The Data API reads end-user bank data, a different capability, and the APIs are only building blocks a developer could use to assemble an export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
